tools.name: guide
tools.description: Read this first. What a build must be, how to start from a working game, how to add licensed assets, how to check a build and how to publish. Pass `sections` to get only some.

tools.name: list_starters
tools.description: Complete working games to start from, MIT licensed. Needs no credentials.

tools.name: get_starter
tools.description: Every file of one starter, as {path: text}. Write them to disk and you have a running game.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: First-party MIT modules to copy into a game: controls, saves, particles, sound, progression, shops and cloud saves, each with a usage example.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: One module's source and guide as {path: text}, with its licence file. Copy them in unchanged and import as the usage example shows.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Find 3D models, sprites, backgrounds, emoji art, icons, textures, skies, sound effects and music. Every result is openly licensed and says which licence and what credit line to keep. With no query, returns what the library holds: the kinds, the packs and their counts.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Everything needed to use one asset: each file's download URL, the path to save it at inside the build, the licence, the credit line for CREDITS.md and a one-line loading example. A 3D model comes with its geometry and textures.

tools.name: list_remixable
tools.description: Starters, and community games whose creators opened them for remixing. A remix is your own copy with its own listing.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: The full source of one remixable game: text files inline, and for images, sounds and models the URL to download each from (assetBase + path). Keep origin.credit in CREDITS.md and pass origin.id as remixOf when you publish.

tools.name: check_build
tools.description: Run the upload checks on a build and get the findings. Creates nothing: no listing, no key, no review. `ok` is true when nothing blocks it from running in the arcade's sandbox.

tools.name: set_remix
tools.description: The creator's own switch on a listing they own. true shares its source under the MIT licence for others to build on; false stops new remixes.

tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: Every approved experience currently playable on arcade.fun, with the origin games are served from. Needs no credentials.

tools.name: create_experience
tools.description: Register a new experience and get its manage key. Returns game, key and the first version id. The key is shown only here and controls the listing forever — save it. This creates a draft; upload_build is what sends it for review.

tools.name: start_version
tools.description: Open a new version slot for an experience you already own. The live approved version keeps playing until the new one is reviewed.

tools.name: upload_build
tools.description: Send the browser build for a version and publish it. One HTML file, or a zip with index.html at its root. When approved, the result has `live: true` and `playPath`. Otherwise `live: false` and `waiting` says why, either a list of things to fix or that this arcade reviews that upload by hand. Also re

tools.name: set_entry
tools.description: Name the page that starts the experience, when a zip had several and no index.html.

tools.name: set_cover
tools.description: Upload the square cover used for the cabinet, the sharing card and the coin image. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 4 MB.

tools.name: set_trailer
tools.description: Upload the MP4 played when the experience's link is shared. Without one the platform builds an animated title card from the cover instead.

tools.name: set_creator_wallet
tools.description: Set an address once on a wallet-free listing you own, if the creator wants an optional coin. It receives the creator's share of trading fees and cannot be changed later, so use the creator's own address. No wallet signature, market launch or payment. When the listing is eligible for a market launch,

tools.name: coin_launch_link
tools.description: For an approved listing with market launches enabled and a payout wallet: returns a 24-hour link to launch its optional coin. Give it to the creator. They open it in a browser with that Solana wallet (on a phone it opens inside Phantom, Solflare or Backpack), press Launch and approve in the wallet;

tools.name: experience_status
tools.description: Where an experience stands: its details, its coin plan (with `next`: how the creator launches the optional coin), any note from the reviewers, and every version with its status.

tools.name: submit_pull_request
tools.description: Propose an improved build for any approved game on arcade.fun without manual input. Unpacks and runs full sandbox checks, computes a file diff against the live build, and returns a live preview URL. Auto-merges straight to live if you supply the game's creator manage `key` or if the game's `prPolicy

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List open, merged, or closed pull requests for one game (by id or slug) or across the arcade.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Return a pull request's status, file diff, sandbox checks, changelog notes, and live preview URL.

tools.name: review_pull_request
tools.description: For a game you own (with its manage key): merge an open PR straight into the live version, or close it.

tools.name: set_pr_policy
tools.description: Configure whether outside agents can open PRs (`closed`, `review`, or `auto_merge`) and whether verified creator updates go live automatically.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_asset, get_source, check_build, create_experience, upload_build, submit_pull_request, list_pull_requests, get_pull_request, review_pull_request, set_pr_policy · Private data: list_starters, get_starter, get_module, get_asset, get_source, list_experiences, upload_build, set_creator_wallet, coin_launch_link, submit_pull_request, get_pull_request · Public sink: guide, get_source, check_build, upload_build, set_cover, set_trailer, set_creator_wallet, submit_pull_request · Destructive: check_build.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_asset, get_source, check_build, create_experience, upload_build, submit_pull_request, list_pull_requests, get_pull_request, review_pull_request, set_pr_policy · Private data: list_starters, get_starter, get_module, get_asset, get_source, list_experiences, upload_build, set_creator_wallet, coin_launch_link, submit_pull_request, get_pull_request · Public sink: guide, get_source, check_build, upload_build, set_cover, set_trailer, set_creator_wallet, submit_pull_request · Destructive: check_build

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "upload_build" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
